basic_profile.bio: A devoted fan of the Nancy Drew series, I've been solving mysteries both in games and in real life for over a decade. Based in Seattle, I work as a software developer by day and a part-time mystery writer by night. I'm a single parent to a lovely 10-year-old who also shares my love for puzzles. My online hours are typically in the evenings after my child goes to sleep, and I enjoy engaging in discussions about gaming, puzzles, and sometimes diving into local mysteries. I dislike toxic online environments and prefer subreddit communities where civility is maintained.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in computer science and have always had a passion for narrative-driven games, particularly those involving mystery and problem-solving. Over the years, I've become quite knowledgeable about game development and voice acting, largely through self-study and participation in gaming communities.
